title: Lazur vs Apple Dictation on Mac: when free built-in dictation is enough
metaTitle: Lazur vs Apple Dictation: which one fits your Mac
description: Lazur vs Apple Dictation on Mac: when free built-in dictation is enough, and when a voice assistant that sees your screen and cleans up text is worth it.
intro: Apple Dictation is free and built into macOS: turn it on in System Settings > Keyboard > Dictation. Lazur adds clean-up and an assistant that sees your screen, for $18/month after a 3-day trial.
tldr: Apple Dictation is a dictation tool. Lazur is a voice assistant that also dictates.
Pick Apple Dictation if typing by voice is all you need.
Pick Lazur if you also want help with what is on your screen: answers, pointing at buttons, step-by-step guidance.
Lazur is free for 3 days, then $18/month.

products.summary: The dictation built into macOS. Turn it on in System Settings > Keyboard > Dictation and start it with the microphone key or your shortcut. Stops after 30 seconds of silence.

verdict: Start with Apple Dictation. It costs nothing. Move to Lazur when you want cleaner text in every app, or help with what is on your screen.

blocks.text: Apple Dictation types what you say; Lazur types it cleanly and can also answer what you ask about your screen.

You want timers, reminders and background research by voice too.

blocks.text: Want numbers for your own typing? Try the [speaking vs typing test](/tools/speaking-vs-typing-test).

faq.question: Is Lazur a good Apple Dictation alternative?
faq.answer: If you want more than dictation, yes. Lazur dictates in any Mac app and also answers questions about your screen, points at buttons and guides you. If you only dictate, Apple Dictation is a fine choice.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur and Apple Dictation together?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as their shortcuts do not clash. Lazur uses hold fn to dictate and hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask.

faq.question: How do I turn on Apple Dictation?
faq.answer: Choose Apple menu > System Settings > Keyboard, turn on Dictation, then click Enable. Start it with the microphone key, your shortcut, or Edit > Start Dictation.
